mentions.name: Muster
mentions.description: A Libghostty-powered terminal for managing AI agents. It lets the user keep an eye on their agents and lets agents (cross-harness included) work together, communicate, and spawn new Muster agents themselves. Recently given a visual refresh and used as a daily driver.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://github.com/amterp/muster is a Libghostty-powered terminal for managing your agents. I just gave it a bit of a visual refresh this weekend and it's looking pretty great imo. It's my daily driver lets me keep an eye on my agents and allow them (cross harness included) to work together, communicate, and spawn new Muster agents themselves.
mentions.author: amterp
